description: The gait styles of the walks and runs of the CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (soma/soma_motions/cmu_walks.somamotion: the steady steps cut out of the BVH takes of cgspeed's release, the clips' own frame rates corrected, the clips that the database lists twice taken once; among them the walks of anger, stealth, a hobble, a heavyset person, drunk, a mummy, sad, shy, scared, macho, sexy, a zombie, a limp, a march, a baby, an old man, a graceful lady, a strong man, carrying a suitcase of 5 to 20 pounds, on toes, crouched, bent forward, with the arms out, and the jogs and runs): how fast the body goes (the clip's own root motion), how long a step is, how high a foot lifts, how far the hips bob, when each leg steps and how high the hips are (`ride`: a share of the plain walk's), in the units of the actor (leg lengths, hips' heights, shares of a cycle), and `upper`: what the hips, the spine, the neck, the head and the hands do over a cycle. A creature takes one with gaits: [{ from: name }]; the numbers are made its own by its legs. Made by soma/tools/gait_tool.js from the loops of soma/tools/bvh_tool.js.
